title: SDP UC-06: preregistration of a Gaia DR4 test for dark companions of star-cluster members
description: Preregistration, committed before Gaia DR4 (2 December 2026), of protocol UC-06 of the Scientific Discovery Platform (SDP). Part A measures how 24 frozen seed clusters change from Gaia DR3 to DR4. Part B tests whether members of star clusters within 1 kpc hold more Gaia DR4 orbits with a dark partner than field stars of the same brightness and distance, with the verdict rule, settings (SHA-256 of the deciding keys a0b6bcd2fd342aca77915e93ca69f75b6ee8c51f2a260ef16b01f89ba0a79aa0) and cluster list (SHA-256 4e4eb5f32a30e3a633d168a096f61aa5f15f7a02d4e20cb3ec217ec55986ccbd) fixed in code. The protocol is docs/protocols/uc06-gaia-dr4-clusters.md and records a Gaia DR3 dry run. The result will be reported whatever it is.
